title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo, Building A on 1969-11-21
lineage: SBD > MR > (Cass in set 1, not set 2) > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with mixed audio fidelity but a stellar second set highlighted by Good Lovin', China Cat > I Know You Rider, High Time and multiple Pigpen showcases.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic second‑set flow, especially the tight Good Lovin' into China Cat Sunflower/​I Know You Rider, a fiery High Time, and four standout Pigpen numbers that give the show its extra spark. Recording quality is uneven – the first six tracks suffer from poor audio while the latter half sounds clean and well‑balanced – but the mix remains acceptable throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently commend the musical performance (especially Pigpen and second‑set songs) while noting clear recording issues on half of the set; weighted average yields a strong but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First six tracks are poor‑quality audio (muddy, low fidelity); tracks 7‑13 are high‑quality with clear mix. Overall mix is fine but the early portion limits listenability.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set shines with strong transitions and Pigpen dominance; first half suffers from recording flaws but the musical performance remains solid throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Fat, cross‑road guitar tone noted, bridging Live Dead and Workingman's Dead eras.
band_member_comments.Keys: Snaky, almost Dylanesque keyboard weaving highlighted on Me And My Uncle; Pigpen's organ is prominently audible in his four songs.
